reason: Primary historical choice chose different calibration levels across models. A chosen recipe failing risk does not identify the model family's inability. This analysis was designed after inspecting primary results and full-grid point summaries; no untouched-test claim.
scope: Retrospective capability of all 35 pre-existing model-plus-offset-level policies. NOT the historical recipe, NOT ex-ante selection, NOT deployment certification or independent confirmation.
strategy_unit: One common q level across all five archived seed instances of a model; never a best q independently selected for each seed.
family: All 8400 coordinates: six conditions times (five instances times35 policy risks plus35x35 mean-cost ratios). Shared draws and a single maximum standardized envelope per block span cover the entire epsilon curve.
identity_comparisons: Exact ratio zero only for same policy or same base model with byte-equal offset values for every seed. Sample action equality alone is not a proof of identical future functions.
risk_and_cost_rule: All seed risk UCBs <=0.10; compare to every possible-feasible competitor whose all-seed lower bounds <=0.10. Resource order is unchanged. All policies are considered for retrospective capability only; no historical-pass filter is applied here.
preservation: No new q levels or models, no caps/tolerances changed, no retraining or original output rewriting. Primary historical-recipe results remain authoritative for that separate question. Secondary success cannot rescue a primary failure.
stop: Report all empty sets and block-span changes. Do not expand epsilon or q to manufacture a selected model. Independent future validation and a history-only reliable choice procedure remain required.
